_how_to_update: Edit a note's status, next, owner and updated, then commit to main. The site and README badges pick it up within a few minutes. Allowed statuses are listed in statuses.

notes.title: peakst8 Embedded Ticketing
notes.summary: Clubs sell events on their own website. Event pages rank on Google and get cited by AI answer engines, while peakst8 runs checkout, payments and check-in. Pilots: Find Your Fit, Sisters in Sweat, Cubbon Classic 10K.
